## Use Latin Modern Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Latin Modern Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Latin Modern Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## About the Latin Modern Mono coding font

The default monospace font for LaTeX. Latin Modern Mono is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Latin Modern Mono is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Latin Modern Mono FAQ

### Is Latin Modern Mono free?

Yes. Latin Modern Mono is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Latin Modern Mono support ligatures?

No. Latin Modern Mono has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Latin Modern Mono?

Latin Modern Mono is available from CTAN and Font Squirrel. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
